description: Make the left sidebar sticky (user task 4). The <aside> in src/components/app-shell.tsx (AppSidebar) currently scrolls away with the page. Make it stay fixed while the main content scrolls. In the current layout (src/routes/_authenticated.tsx: outer div 'min-h-screen flex bg-background'; aside 'hidden lg:flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col'), the standard fix is to make the aside 'sticky top-0 h-screen' so it pins to the top and spans the viewport height, with its inner <nav> (which already has 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto') scrolling independently. Header and footer user-block must stay visible; only the nav list scrolls if it overflows. Must not break MobileTabBar or the responsive 'hidden lg:flex' behavior.
